alt: Poster: Regulatory Pulse - SEBI circular dated 1 October 2026 on investor-awareness messages by stock brokers: websites from 5 Oct and landing page from 1 Nov; trading apps optional until 31 Oct, then awareness messages and risk disclosures on alternate days
text:
From 1 November, SEBI's investor-awareness messages move from a transition phase to a mandatory display on broker landing pages.

Under SEBI's circular dated 1 October 2026 (Project Jagrook), stock brokers must show SEBI-supplied investor-awareness messages alongside their existing risk disclosures. For broker websites this began on 5 October; from 1 November the awareness message must appear on the website landing page.

For trading apps, display was voluntary from 5 to 31 October (on a day an app showed the message, the risk disclosure was optional that day). From 1 November, brokers with apps must show the awareness messages and the risk disclosures on alternate days, with the awareness message on the app's landing page. The circular supplements the 19 May 2023 risk-disclosure circular; it does not withdraw it. Exchanges and depositories must pass the requirement on to their members, and SEBI may modify the messages from time to time.

Our reading: standardised, regulator-written messages shown on the first screen are a low-cost way to reach investors before they place an order. This is an opinion, not advice.

For practitioners: have you noticed these messages on your broker's app or website yet, and do they change how you brief new clients?
